name: Details Field
description: Provides a field type, widget and formatter for creating and displaying HTML details/summary (disclosure) elements.
project_description:
Details Field provides a tailored field type, widget and formatter that allows easily creating and displaying HTML details elements.

After installing and enabling the module, a new field type called Details element becomes available under the Formatted text category. This field type can be used for any entity type, such as nodes, blocks, and paragraphs.

The module also provides a customised field widget that lets editors easily create and manage details elements, setting the summary, content, and per-element attributes (open, name, id, class, aria-label) to control the details element's behaviour as per the HTML element definition.
